prefix: Photorealistic costume reference photograph of one person standing alone, full length from head to feet, front view, standing naturally, arms relaxed, empty hands, plain white studio background, soft even light, no text. Hellenistic Greece, 3rd century BC. Clothes of hand-woven wool and linen, each garment one woven rectangle, draped, pinned or belted, never tailored.
sandals: Simple flat leather sandals held on by thin thongs tied round the ankle.

kinds.mercenary: A hired soldier, a lean weathered man of about thirty, short dark hair and a short dark beard, an ordinary face with nothing distinctive, bare-headed. A knee-length {colour} wool tunic under a stiff white linen corslet, with shoulder flaps tied down on the chest and a skirt of hanging linen strips at the hips. A {colour} wool cloak pinned at the right shoulder and hanging down his back. Bronze greaves. {sandals}
kinds.bandit: A hill bandit, a rough man of about thirty-five, dark hair and a full dark beard, an ordinary face with nothing distinctive, bare-headed. A knee-length {colour} wool tunic with a plain leather belt, and a {colour} wool cloak, a flat rectangle pinned at the right shoulder and hanging down his back, his neck and head bare. Bronze bracers on both forearms. {sandals}
kinds.arche-messenger: A young man, a messenger, bare-headed, short dark hair. A short undyed wool exomis, one rectangle of cloth pinned at the left shoulder and belted at the waist, leaving his right shoulder, arm and chest bare. A soft hide sack on a cord across his body.{extra} {sandals}
kinds.accountant: A middle-aged man, a trading house's accountant, short grey-flecked beard. An undyed wool chiton, ankle-length, falling to his feet, and a brown wool himation wrapped round his body and thrown over his left shoulder and arm. {sandals}
kinds.clerk: A young man, a clerk of a trading house, clean-shaven, short dark hair. An undyed linen chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders and belted, and a small wax tablet hanging from the belt on a cord. {sandals}
kinds.legislator-man: A white-bearded old man, a legislator. A white linen chiton, ankle-length, falling to his feet, pinned along both upper arms with small bronze pins, a purple cord belt at the waist and a purple woven band at the hem. {sandals}
kinds.legislator-woman: A grey-haired woman, a legislator, hair gathered at the back. A white linen chiton, ankle-length, falling to her feet, pinned along both upper arms with small bronze pins, a purple cord belt at the waist and a purple woven band at the hem. {sandals}
kinds.priest: An old white-haired man, a priest, an olive wreath on his head. A plain white linen chiton, ankle-length, falling to his feet, pinned along both upper arms with small bronze pins, a red cord belt. {sandals}
kinds.paxos-messenger: A young man, a messenger, bare-headed, curly dark hair. A short blue wool exomis, one rectangle of cloth pinned at the left shoulder and belted at the waist, leaving his right shoulder, arm and chest bare. A soft hide sack on a cord at his hip. {sandals}
kinds.merchant: A plump middle-aged man, a merchant, short beard. A short cream wool chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders, with an ochre woven band at the hem, a cord belt and a small hide sack on a cord at his hip. {sandals}
kinds.goatherd: A wiry weathered goatherd of about forty, unkempt hair and beard. A rough brown wool exomis to mid-thigh, pinned at the left shoulder, tied at the waist with a rope, leaving his right shoulder bare; nothing under it, bare legs. Bare feet.
kinds.scholar: A lean thoughtful man of about fifty, a scholar, short grey beard. A short grey wool chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders, a cord belt. {sandals}
kinds.librarian: A woman of about forty-five, a librarian, dark hair pinned up. An undyed cream wool chiton, ankle-length, falling to her feet, pinned along both upper arms, a cord belt. {sandals}
kinds.council: A {who}, a council member of a small Greek city, an ordinary face with nothing distinctive. A {colour} wool chiton, ankle-length, falling to the feet, and a {colour} wool himation wrapped round the body and thrown over the left shoulder and arm. {sandals}
kinds.runner: A lean young man of about twenty, a runner, short dark hair, bare-headed. A short undyed brown wool tunic belted at the waist, bare arms and legs. {sandals}
kinds.priestess: An older woman, a priestess, calm, grey-haired. A white wool peplos, ankle-length, falling to her feet, pinned at both shoulders with its folded-over top hanging to the waist, belted, and a white veil over her hair falling to her shoulders. {sandals}
kinds.student-man: A young man of about eighteen, a student, short hair, bare-headed, an ordinary face with nothing distinctive. A plain {colour} chiton to the knee, pinned at both shoulders and belted at the waist. {sandals}
kinds.student-woman: A young woman of about eighteen, a student, hair tied back, bare-headed, an ordinary face with nothing distinctive. A plain {colour} chiton, ankle-length, falling to her feet, pinned along both upper arms and belted at the waist. {sandals}

characters.extra: A broad red sash worn across his chest from shoulder to hip.
